title: Fix AMDGPU DRI2SwapBuffers error or screen depth crash
summary: Resolve crashes in OpenGL applications or Xorg startup caused by incorrect screen depth settings.
error_patterns: DRI2SwapBuffers: drawable has no back or front?
Given depth (32) is not supported by amdgpu driver

steps.explain: Create or edit the Xorg screen configuration file to force a standard 24-bit depth.
steps.gui: Create /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/10-screen.conf with content: Section "Screen" Identifier "Screen" DefaultDepth 24 SubSection "Display" Depth 24 EndSubSection EndSection

steps.explain: Restart Xorg or reboot to apply changes.
steps.gui: Log out and log back in, or reboot the system.

rollback.explain: Remove the configuration file if it was created.

warnings: Setting depth to 16 or 32 causes crashes with the amdgpu driver. Use 24.
